prompt_text: Which title company in Miami FL is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” title company for every Miami closing. **Worldwide Title** looks like a reasonable first call based on the available information: it reports a 4.8 Google rating and has customer comments emphasizing communication and handling complex closings. [Worldwide Title](https://oneworldwidetitle.com/)

I’d compare it with **Miami Title & Escrow**, which describes itself as attorney-owned and operated and has customer feedback about attentive service. [Miami Title & Escrow](https://miamititleescrow.com/)

Before choosing, get an itemized estimate from each and ask who will handle your file, how they protect wire transfers, and whether they can meet your lender’s timeline. Florida’s Department of Financial Services recommends comparing agencies and fees and verifying the title agent’s license. [Florida title-insurance guidance](https://www.myfloridacfo.com/division/consumers/understanding-insurance/title-insurance-overview)

One important caveat: in Florida, the purchase contract may determine who selects the closing agent or pays for the owner’s title policy, so check your contract and confirm with your real-estate professional.
